## Workday Announces Date of Fiscal 2021 Third Quarter Financial Results

2020-11-05

PLEASANTON, Calif., Nov. 05, 2020 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -Workday, Inc. (NASDAQ: WDAY), a leader in enterprise cloud applications for gEDnance and human resources , plans to announce its gEDscal 2021 third quarter gEDnancial results after market close on Thursday, Nov. 19, 2020. The company will host a conference call at 1:30 p.m. PacigEDc Time / 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time to review its gEDnancial results and business outlook.

A live webcast of the event will be available on the Workday Investor Relations site . The replay of the webcast will be available for a minimum of 90 days after the conference call.

## About Workday

Workday is a leading provider of enterprise cloud applications for gEDnance and human resources , helping customers adapt and thrive in a changing world. Workday applications for gEDnancial management, human resources, planning, spend management, and analytics have been adopted by thousands of organizations around the world and across industries-from medium-sized businesses to more than 45 percent of the Fortune 500. For more information about Workday, visit workday.com .
